## Where I'm from

I am from Punjab, India. I grew up there and later moved to Mumbai for my
undergraduate studies, before coming to Vancouver for the MDS program at UBC.

## Before MDS

I studied Physics at IIT Bombay and graduated in 2017. Physics taught me to
think carefully about data, models and uncertainty, which is what drew me toward
data science in the first place.

## What I enjoy

I love to read, work out, cook and watch art-house movies. I also enjoy spelling
bee and other word games. I miss my dog Peanut a lot.

## What's next

I'm excited to be here, meet new people and learn a ton. By the end of the
program I hope to apply data science to real-world problems, ideally in a role
where I can keep learning from the people around me.
